subject: Quick reconnect — last-week bump and approval signal for SearchLytics
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@searchlytics.ai>, Elena Morales <elena@searchlytics.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & next steps from today — SearchLytics discovery

Hi Amit / Elena —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- What we heard: you want a low-latency embeddings pipeline for semantic search across customer docs + the ability to host sensitive models in a VPC for regulated clients.
- Success metric you mentioned: reduce avg search latency below 120ms and keep per-query inference cost under $0.015 at 5k qps.
- Proposed pilot: 6-week PoC (2 GPUs dedicated), integration support, and an eval suite for perf/quality.

Next steps (suggested):
1) I’ll share the discovery deck and a draft mutual action plan (attached).
2) You confirm internal stakeholders for compliance and procurement (legal + IT security).
3) If approved, propose kickoff week of Nov 15 (dates flexible).

Attachments: discovery deck (searchlytics-discovery-deck.pdf), MAP draft (ma_plan-draft.xlsx).

If timing has shifted for budget/approval or Q4 priorities, say so — want to make sure we either pause or accelerate accordingly.

Best,
Priya
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Subject: Quick nudge — EOQ timing + approval check for SearchLytics

Hi Amit / Elena —

Following up on the deck I shared and Elena’s note — wanted to check if the pilot is still on track for this quarter or if you need to shift to Q1. A few quick options so we can plan on our side:

- Green: procurement + security confirm this week, kickoff week of Nov 15 (we can hold seats).
- Need a little runway: finance pushed to early Dec — we can stagger kickoff and hold a short technical review first.
- Pause: you prefer to defer until next quarter.

If it helps, Ben can offer a $3k pilot credit to shorten procurement approvals — happy to have him looped on the confirmation.

Would appreciate a quick reply with which option fits best. If you prefer a 10-min sync I can set that up Friday.

Thanks —
Priya
